content:
noah: quick alert  found a batch of NetSuite backfill jobs that created invoices with duplicate external_ref. Customers are getting confused and some payments misapplied.

priya: how many? any pattern?

noah: ~28 invoices from backfill run 2026-07-01T02:10Z. Root cause: backfill script used Stripe invoice.id when absence of netsuite_ref and a race allowed two workers to create records for the same subscription.

devon: logs show the backfill didn't use our global create-if-not-exists lock. I think recent refactor removed the mutex to speed up runs.

zoe: payment application logic matches on external_ref, so duplicates meant one invoice got paid and the other remained open.

billing-bot: Scan: 28 dup refs, 18 unpaid duplicates, total outstanding $6,120. Ticket FIN-BACKFILL-2026-021 created.

priya: immediate remediation: pause backfills, re-run dedupe that merges invoices by external_ref and attaches payments to canonical invoice, then void duplicates. Add manual review for >$1k.

noah: I'll pause scheduled backfill now and prepare dedupe script (will output CSV).

devon: I'll add the mutex back and write a small test that simulates concurrent backfill workers.

zoe: finance, please sign off on auto-merge threshold $1,000.

priya: finance ok for <=$1k auto-merge. >$1k manual.

noah: dedupe dry-run: would-merge 18 invoices, would-void 10, flagged 4 >$1k. CSV uploaded to FIN ticket.

billing-bot: Backfill job paused at 2026-07-01T03:05Z by ops.

noah: after merge we'll reconcile payments and notify affected customers. Postmortem + runbook updates incoming. Closing thread.
